deviations: In a document with no rows (deploy order), a deleted-then-retyped identical paragraph takes the deleted one's version text under the retyped id: text-true, identity unknowable without rows.
Decision 22 (architect, ship as is): a block only a closed document's live text holds has no row until a settlement versions it; its #b- reference resolves after the reopen.
Residual: a stored row indexed at an older version whose text the latest version changed is still recorded deleted at the latest version.
Added a marked_at guard: the closed-issue path indexes the live text only while the pending settlement's marked_at under the lock equals the listed one, since the live text is read before the lock.

The reviewer suggested indexing pmdoc.ParseRendering(stored)'s blocks; that parse mints random ids for every untyped block (a version's markdown names only typed blocks' ids), so the fix indexes the version's rendering under the live document's block ids, and only when the live text differs from the version in ask blocks' attributes alone.

The fingerprint changed: main's #2210 added the block-index reconciliation, a leased loop, so this branch's ask repair is the tenth lease caller (leasePoolSize 10, not 9) and the README counts eight loops, not seven.
